recent_articles.rephrased_article: A mob of protesters, angered by the detention of several locals for alleged encroachment on forest land, attacked an office of the **Assam Forest Department** in Chirang district. The violence resulted in damage to government property and injuries to over 30 people, including police personnel.  The clash intensified after police used force to control the situation, leading to the arrest of at least four protesters. The incident occurred following a previous protest on Thursday night where members of the Adivasi community demanded the release of those detained.

recent_articles.title: Muslims the target? Fury as millions lose voting rights in India’s Bengal | Elections News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India (ECI)** revised its electoral rolls in West Bengal, resulting in the deletion of voter names from over nine million people. The process, called a special intensive revision (SIR), has been controversial and is accused by opposition parties and Muslim groups of targeting voters unlikely to vote for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).  The ECI claims the SIR aims to remove duplicate or deceased voters but critics argue it disproportionately affects Muslims. The process has faced legal challenges, with the Supreme Court allowing those whose cases are pending before tribunals to vote in the upcoming election. Muslim families across West Bengal report difficulties proving their voting rights, citing discrepancies in spellings, changes of surnames after marriage, and issues with residency status.  The ECI maintains that the SIR is a routine activity but critics argue it lacks transparency and places an excessive burden on female voters who often lack required documents.

recent_articles.title: Samrat Choudhary sworn in as Bihar’s first BJP CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, newly elected leader of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**, was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Bihar on Wednesday.  He was accompanied by two senior JD(U) leaders, **Bijendra Prasad Yadav** and **Vijay Kumar Choudhary**, who are expected to serve as Deputy CMs. The swearing-in ceremony took place at Lok Bhawan with prominent figures from the BJP and former CM Nitish Kumar in attendance.  The new government is expected to expand after the results of upcoming state elections.

recent_articles.title: Meghalaya yields new burrowing reed snake - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A team of researchers from multiple institutions, including **Help Earth**, **Cotton University**, and the **Zoological Survey of India**, have described a new species of burrowing reed snake called *Calamaria garoensis* found in Meghalaya's West Garo Hills district. The study, published in Taprobanica, confirmed that this species is distinct from other related species based on morphological examination and mitochondrial DNA analysis.  The discovery highlights the rich biodiversity of the region and emphasizes the need for further research and conservation efforts to protect these often overlooked creatures.

recent_articles.title: Supreme Court expresses ‘shock’ at the impunity of Chambal sand miners - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** expressed shock at the impunity of sand miners operating in the Chambal sanctuary zone, resulting in the death of a forest guard and damage to bridge foundations. The court criticized the **Madhya Pradesh government**, suggesting it either failed to control illegal mining or was complicit in these activities.  The court urged authorities to explore installing high-resolution CCTV cameras and GPS systems to monitor illegal mining.

recent_articles.title: Tear gas fired at India workers demanding higher wages as living costs rise | Workers' Rights News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** in Noida, India used tear gas to disperse a violent protest by factory workers demanding higher wages. The demonstration, which began four days ago and involved the torching of vehicles and stone-throwing, was sparked by rising living costs globally following the US-Israel war on Iran. **Gautam Budh Nagar police** stated that "minimum force" was used to maintain order while local lawmaker **Narendra Kashyap** urged protesters to discuss their demands with the government.

recent_articles.title: Consolidated voters’ list of 9 States and 3 UTs that underwent SIR Phase II trimmed by 10.2% - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India** announced the results of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in nine states and three Union Territories. **Uttar Pradesh** recorded the highest net deletion of voters at 2.04 crore, followed by **West Bengal**, with a net deletion of 83.86 lakh. The SIR phase II identified 67 lakh deceased voters and 1.28 crore duplicate voters across these states and UTs.  The consolidated electoral rolls saw a reduction of 10.2%, bringing the number of active voters down to 45.81 crore.
